//TR: Bu dosya agent/model değişse bile şirketin mühendislik ve karar kalitesinin sabit kalması için merkezi teknik standartları register eder.

standards.name: API Contract Standard
standards.summary: OpenAPI/JSON Schema/source-of-truth, versioning, compatibility, auth, errors, idempotency and evidence.

standards.name: Strict JSON Response Validation Standard
standards.summary: Ajv/Postman/Newman, required/type/null/empty/additionalProperties/header/business assertion and redaction rules.

standards.name: Android Engineering Standard
standards.summary: Kotlin/Java, Compose, architecture, coroutines, storage, networking, testing, performance, security and release.

standards.name: iOS Engineering Standard
standards.summary: Swift/SwiftUI/UIKit, concurrency, persistence, testing, instruments, signing and release.

standards.name: Web Engineering Standard
standards.summary: Web platform, TypeScript/frameworks, accessibility, performance, security, testing and observability.

standards.name: Backend Engineering Standard
standards.summary: Contracts, validation, auth, transactions, concurrency, resilience, background work, observability and shutdown.

standards.name: Database Engineering Standard
standards.summary: Modeling, constraints, transactions, indexing, migrations, backup/restore, performance and data integrity.

standards.name: Universal Quality Engineering Standard
standards.summary: Risk-based cross-layer coverage, negative/state/concurrency, evidence and explicit unknowns.

standards.name: Test Automation Framework Standard
standards.summary: Deterministic locators/clients, fixtures, parallelism, flake control, evidence, retries and reporting.

standards.name: Authorized Security Assessment Standard
standards.summary: Explicit authorization, scope, safe proof, OWASP mapping, evidence, remediation and retest.

standards.name: Performance Engineering Standard
standards.summary: Workload model, percentiles, saturation, abort guards, stress/soak and correlated telemetry.

standards.name: Observability Standard
standards.summary: Structured logs, metrics, traces, context propagation, SLOs and diagnostic evidence.

standards.name: Accessibility Standard
standards.summary: WCAG, keyboard/focus, semantics, screen readers, contrast, reflow and mobile/desktop coverage.

standards.name: Localization Standard
standards.summary: Unicode, RTL, text expansion, locale/timezone/currency/pluralization and pseudo-localization.

standards.name: AI/LLM Engineering & Assurance Standard
standards.summary: Prompt/model provenance, evals, RAG, injection defense, leakage, cost/latency and holdout integrity.

standards.name: Game Engineering Standard
standards.summary: Engine architecture, determinism/networking, economy invariants, performance, builds and authorized analysis.

standards.name: Embedded/IoT Standard
standards.summary: Firmware lifecycle, OTA, device identity, HIL, protocols, safety boundaries and evidence.

standards.name: Technology Decision Standard
standards.summary: Project genome, alternatives, fit criteria, evidence, trade-offs, exit strategy and ADR.

standards.name: Dependency & Supply Chain Standard
standards.summary: Provenance, license, SBOM, vulnerabilities, version policy, updates and reproducibility.

standards.name: Code Review Standard
standards.summary: Correctness, design, testability, security, performance, maintainability, evidence and scope.

standards.name: Evidence & Attestation Standard
standards.summary: Run/commit/env/tool/resource/time hashes, DLP, provenance, stale/invalidation semantics.

standards.name: Technical Research Standard
standards.summary: Official-source hierarchy, freshness, conflict tracking, clean-room boundaries and citations.

standards.name: Technical Leadership Review Standard
standards.summary: Specialist→Lead→Head→Council compression, dissent capture, escalation and decision provenance.
